communes: Alhandra, São João Dos Montes E Calhandriz

blurb.text: A Lisboa wine region around the town of Arruda dos Vinhos, known mainly for red wine. Its wines are made from allowed grapes such as Castelão, Touriga Nacional, Aragonez and Alicante Bouschet, with Arinto and Fernão Pires among the whites.
